label: 10. On a hot summer's day, nothing beats a...

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: On a hot summer's day, nothing beats a...
Glass of iced coffee.
Glass of ice-cold soda.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: don't tell me you don't know my drink preferences?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You of all people should know I prefer a cold soda.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Anyways,

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You said it!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Nothing like an ice-cold soda to beat the heat.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: On that note,

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: are you planning on installing an icebox in the Commander's Room?
An icebox?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: The freezer we've got is way too small.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I end up using all the ice we've got in just one drink.
Can't you just ease up on the ice?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Out of the question.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: If I did that, it'd all melt instantly.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Besides,

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I'm all about munching on the leftover ice.
How about adding more ice cube trays in the freezer?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I don't think there's enough space for that.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Neon recently bought a few tubs of ice cream,

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: and I got a whole buncha soda ice lollies, since they were on sale.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: So there isn't much room to spare in the freezer.
Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: C'mon Commander, pleeaaaasee?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: If we have more ice

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: you can have an iced coffee whenever you're feeling tired.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Or, whenever you're getting frustrated, you can treat yourself to ice water and calm your nerves.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: There's a whole bunch of other cold drinks you could enjoy too.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Waddya say?
Fine, we can go shopping for an icebox later.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Yahoo!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You're not pulling my leg, are you?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Yipee! This is so exciting!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Thanks a bunch, Commander!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I owe you big time!
